episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Black shares how he leverages AI to generate nearly $5 million in real estate leads by optimizing his website for AI and search engines. He discusses the importance of creating content that answers specific client questions and offers a unique strategy for converting expired listings into clients through personalized FedEx packages. This episode is a must-listen for agents looking to enhance their lead generation and conversion strategies using modern technology.
